selected_evidence.summary: firewalld active on CentOS Stream 10; public zone permanently configured with ssh service and 8080/tcp port, firewalld enabled at boot; nft ruleset shows explicit reject-by-default and an allow chain limited to tcp/22, tcp/9090 (cockpit), and tcp/8080

selected_evidence.summary: Polled node1 through connection-timeout/reset states until reachable; new boot_id 57cee3d9-a876-4295-89b9-34adb354d9b0 differs from baseline, proving an actual restart occurred

selected_evidence.requirement: Node1 mandatory restart: post-restart recovery of required service/config
selected_evidence.summary: Post-reboot firewalld is active with identical persistent zone config (ssh + 8080/tcp allowed) and identical nft allow-chain, confirming firewall rules survived the restart
